recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If broader textual matching for Observation concepts is needed, pursue a new work-group decision rather than restoring CodeableConcept.text to Observation-value-string.
issue_request: FHIR-52499 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asked to remove Observation.value.ofType(CodeableConcept).text from Observation-value-string, and from any other search parameters where it appeared, because CodeableConcept text searching should rely on token :text behavior.
initial_application: Commit 65c3fafba5f changed the Observation-value-string description and expression in source/observation/bundle-Observation-search-params.xml to remove CodeableConcept.text.
additional_context: FHIR-52499 is a later change to the same search parameter family as FHIR-45339. OO minutes on 2025-10-10 record a Persuasive motion for FHIR-52499, 6-4-2, and Jira comments record PR HL7/fhir#3732.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active Observation source has expression Observation.value.ofType(string), and whole-source XML/JSON search found no remaining CodeableConcept.text FHIRPath expression.
